decisions.reason: The burner component supports the firm's core gas radiant heater business, so it is only mentioned and carries little risk relative to aspirations tied to established operations.

Electric panel heaters fit the electrification shift in German heating demand after the 2022 energy crisis, and their dedicated page signals commitment, though competition from many low-cost suppliers may push results below aspiration.
The halogen infrared heater extends the firm's radiant expertise into electric spot heating with modest resource needs, so slack allows keeping it while results remain uncertain.

Industrial electric hall heaters sit close to the firm's core industrial hall heating customers and hedge against gas phase-out, making the product a strategic response rather than a candidate for problemistic search.
The hydrogen-capable gas heater series is the firm's flagship answer to decarbonisation, already demonstrated in real operation in Ulm, so management will keep it despite uncertain early sales.
